build_autoencoder_kl_hunyuan: build a python module to instantiate AutoencoderKLHunyuanImageRefiner with custom block channels and compression ratios

decode_video_latents: decode latent vectors back into video frames using AutoencoderKLHunyuanImageRefiner decode method
